title: The scattering of α and β particles by matter and the structure of the atom
lineage: Inspected primary text or later historical source; see locator and qualification.

passages.note: In the May 1911 paper Rutherford used Geiger–Marsden observations and an intense concentrated atomic charge to account for large-angle scattering. The credited observations date from 1909 and 1910. A February 1911 oral account is mentioned. The model predates the neutron and modern nuclear theory.
